001package com.streamconverter.command.rule.impl.casing;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
004import java.util.Locale;
005
006/**
007 * Transforms camelCase strings to snake_case format.
008 *
009 * <p>This rule converts strings from camelCase notation to snake_case notation by inserting
010 * underscores before uppercase letters and converting all letters to lowercase.
011 *
012 * <p>Examples:
013 *
014 * <ul>
015 *   <li>{@code userName} → {@code user_name}
016 *   <li>{@code firstName} → {@code first_name}
017 *   <li>{@code userAccountID} → {@code user_account_id}
018 *   <li>{@code XMLHttpRequest} → {@code xml_http_request}
019 * </ul>
020 *
021 * <p>Usage:
022 *
023 * <pre>{@code
024 * IRule rule = CamelToSnakeCaseRule.builder().build();
025 * IStreamCommand command = JsonWalker.create(TreePath.fromJson("$.userName"), rule);
026 * }</pre>
027 *
028 * @since 1.0
029 */
030public class CamelToSnakeCaseRule implements IRule {
031
032  /** Common acronyms that should be split when found consecutively */
033  private static final String[] COMMON_ACRONYMS = {
034    "JSON", "XML", "API", "URL", "HTTP", "HTTPS", "FTP", "SQL", "HTML", "CSS", "JS", "REST", "SOAP"
035  };
036
037  /** Whether to preserve leading/trailing underscores */
038  private final boolean preserveUnderscores;
039
040  /** Whether to handle acronyms specially */
041  private final boolean handleAcronyms;
042
043  /** Private constructor for builder pattern */
044  private CamelToSnakeCaseRule(boolean preserveUnderscores, boolean handleAcronyms) {
045    this.preserveUnderscores = preserveUnderscores;
046    this.handleAcronyms = handleAcronyms;
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  public String apply(String input) {
051    if (input == null || input.isEmpty()) {
052      return input;
053    }
054
055    String result;
056
057    if (handleAcronyms) {
058      result = processWithAcronyms(input);
059    } else {
060      // Simple camelCase conversion - separate ALL uppercase letters
061      result = processWithoutAcronyms(input);
062    }
063
064    // Convert to lowercase
065    result = result.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
066
067    // Clean up multiple underscores if not preserving
068    if (!preserveUnderscores) {
069      result = result.replaceAll("_{2,}", "_");
070      // Remove leading/trailing underscores
071      result = result.replaceAll("^_+|_+$", "");
072    }
073
074    return result;
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Processes input with proper acronym handling using character-by-character analysis.
079   *
080   * @param input the input string to process
081   * @return processed string with underscores inserted at proper boundaries
082   */
083  private String processWithAcronyms(String input) {
084    // Use a three-pass approach for better acronym handling
085    String result = input;
086
087    // Pass 1: Handle consecutive acronyms like JSONAPI -> JSON_API FIRST
088    // This must happen before other transformations
089    result = splitConsecutiveAcronyms(result);
090
091    // Pass 2: Insert underscores between lowercase/digit/underscore and uppercase
092    // Include underscore in the pattern if preserving underscores
093    String lowercasePattern = preserveUnderscores ? "([a-z0-9_])([A-Z])" : "([a-z0-9])([A-Z])";
094    result = result.replaceAll(lowercasePattern, "$1_$2");
095
096    // Pass 3: Insert underscores before uppercase that's followed by lowercase (end of acronym)
097    result = result.replaceAll("([A-Z])([A-Z][a-z])", "$1_$2");
098
099    return result;
100  }
101
102  /**
103   * Processes input without acronym handling - separates EVERY uppercase letter.
104   *
105   * @param input the input string to process
106   * @return processed string with underscores between every case transition
107   */
108  private String processWithoutAcronyms(String input) {
109    if (input.length() <= 1) {
110      return input;
111    }
112
113    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
114    char[] chars = input.toCharArray();
115
116    for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
117      char current = chars[i];
118      char previous = i > 0 ? chars[i - 1] : '\0';
119
120      // Add underscore before current character if:
121      // 1. Previous is lowercase/digit and current is uppercase
122      // 2. Previous is uppercase and current is uppercase (separate all uppercase)
123      if (i > 0
124          && Character.isUpperCase(current)
125          && (Character.isLowerCase(previous)
126              || Character.isDigit(previous)
127              || Character.isUpperCase(previous))) {
128        result.append('_');
129      }
130
131      result.append(current);
132    }
133
134    return result.toString();
135  }
136
137  /**
138   * Splits consecutive acronyms based on configurable patterns. This method uses a dictionary
139   * approach to identify and split consecutive acronyms like JSONAPI -> JSON_API
140   */
141  private String splitConsecutiveAcronyms(String input) {
142    String result = input;
143
144    // For each acronym, split if it is immediately followed by another uppercase sequence (length
145    // >= 3)
146    for (String acronym : COMMON_ACRONYMS) {
147      // Use regex to match the acronym followed by another uppercase sequence of length >= 3
148      // e.g., JSONAPI -> JSON_API, XMLHTTPS -> XML_HTTPS
149      result = result.replaceAll(acronym + "([A-Z]{3,})", acronym + "_$1");
150    }
151
152    return result;
153  }
154
155  /**
156   * Creates a builder for configuring the CamelToSnakeCaseRule.
157   *
158   * @return new builder instance
159   */
160  public static Builder builder() {
161    return new Builder();
162  }
163
164  /**
165   * Creates a CamelToSnakeCaseRule with default settings.
166   *
167   * @return new rule instance with default configuration
168   */
169  public static CamelToSnakeCaseRule create() {
170    return new Builder().build();
171  }
172
173  /** Builder class for CamelToSnakeCaseRule configuration. */
174  public static class Builder {
175    private boolean preserveUnderscoresFlag;
176    private boolean handleAcronymsFlag;
177
178    /** Creates a builder with the default configuration. */
179    public Builder() {
180      this.preserveUnderscoresFlag = false;
181      this.handleAcronymsFlag = true;
182    }
183
184    /**
185     * Sets whether to preserve existing underscores in the input.
186     *
187     * @param preserve true to preserve underscores, false to clean them up
188     * @return this builder
189     */
190    public Builder preserveUnderscores(boolean preserve) {
191      this.preserveUnderscoresFlag = preserve;
192      return this;
193    }
194
195    /**
196     * Sets whether to handle acronyms specially (e.g., XMLHttpRequest → xml_http_request).
197     *
198     * @param handle true to handle acronyms, false to treat them as regular uppercase
199     * @return this builder
200     */
201    public Builder handleAcronyms(boolean handle) {
202      this.handleAcronymsFlag = handle;
203      return this;
204    }
205
206    /**
207     * Builds the CamelToSnakeCaseRule with current configuration.
208     *
209     * @return configured rule instance
210     */
211    public CamelToSnakeCaseRule build() {
212      return new CamelToSnakeCaseRule(preserveUnderscoresFlag, handleAcronymsFlag);
213    }
214  }
215
216  @Override
217  public String toString() {
218    return String.format(
219        "CamelToSnakeCaseRule{preserveUnderscores=%s, handleAcronyms=%s}",
220        preserveUnderscores, handleAcronyms);
221  }
222}
